Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nijman" where he says, self-pity and soliciting for sympathy doesn't get us anywhere. It is always wise to keep our troubles with ourselves to not get ridiculed.

Javed Akhtar says in olden times a qasid i.e. messenger used to deliver messages across villages. People used to deliver their messages to each other through these messengers which gave rise to the essence of life.
Javed Akhtar takes us through various shayaris where sharab is used as a symbol to explain a concept that talks about various examples of life.
Javed Akhtar talks about the word 'Awaaz' and its various forms, the one that we use to talk to others, the one that we raise as an opinion and the one that is within us.

Javed Akhtar says every human has some thoughts and expectations from life. He further says life is a formation of various elements and is full of ups and downs while death is a destruction of these elements.

Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Dekhi" where he says, do not forget the small things in life after seeing big ones, as everything whether big or small is useful in some or the other way.

Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Roothe Sujan Maniye" where he says, if your family or friends are offended, you should try your best to convince & win them back not just once but multiple times.

Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's doha "Rahiman Nij Sampatti" where he uses the metaphor of a blooming lotus in a pond to prove that only your hard work, calibre & effort can get you through challenges.
Javed Akhtar interprets Rahim's Doha "Pharzi Sah" where he says, if one tries to achieve something through immoral ways he would fail in doing so, therefore always be kind & righteous in your ways.
